caption: The drawing depicts a single object resembling a brown rabbit, positioned upright on its haunches and facing to the left. The rabbit's eye is yellow with a black center and a white highlight. Its ear has a reddish-brown interior, and the nose and mouth are shown with minimal lines. The surface of the rabbit is shaded with various brown tones and some lighter highlights, suggesting a shiny or glazed texture. The rabbit sits on a rectangular green base with hints of white and some uneven color patches. The background is plain and off-white, with some small brownish spots scattered mostly along the edges of the drawing. No additional objects or decorative elements are present in the composition.
title: Seated Chalkware Rabbit
